DIAGNOSIS READY: Advanced Gastric Lymphoma.

The clinical picture of supraclavicular lymphadenopathy, "B symptoms" (night sweats, weight loss), and abdominal pain suggests a systemic malignancy. Given the location of the nodes and abdominal symptoms, I am concerned with a gastric or systemic lymphoma. The liver function tests are not available; please request an urgent upper endoscopy with biopsy and CT scan of the chest/abdomen/pelvis.
